Critical Mass Köln

Köln, Germany · Critical Mass · Social

Critical Mass Köln is a Critical Mass ride in Köln, Germany. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:00 pm local time from Rudolfplatz. About 30 km (19 miles), mass pace, set by the crowd.

For visitors

Free, no sign-up and no leader. Numbers swing with the season: about 25 riders in June 2026, 246 in September. Bring lights.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: mass pace, set by the crowd.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Critical Mass Köln group ride

Cologne's monthly mass ride leaves the Rudolfplatz on the last Friday at 6:00 pm. The September 2026 ride ran about 30 km. Riders on the platform estimated 246 for Sept 25 and 80 for Aug 28.
